edits.new:
Then the system answers 404 with the platform error envelope and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC11 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key (no legacy origin; exception X7, rule BR8)
    Given case RC-2026-000716 was removed and its answer was stored under an Idempotency-Key
    When the same write is replayed with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the stored answer is returned and no second move is sent to rwb-case
    Then no second decision record is written

  Scenario: AC12 Retried or timed-out activity (no legacy origin; exception X5)
    Given the removal activity of case RC-2026-000716 is retried after the rwb-case contract mock did not answer inside 2 s
    When the retry runs
    Then the case move is answered at most once and no duplicate decision record exists
    Then the activity result is the one recorded on the first successful attempt
